# Kitchener HVAC Pros

> Serving Kitchener and the wider Waterloo Region region, Kitchener HVAC Pros is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (519) 745-2083  |  Email: contact@kitchenerhvacpros.ca  |  Website: https://kitchenerhvacpros.ca

Service areas: Kitchener, Cambridge, Waterloo, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
